verdict.rationale: incident.io's own docs cover all three parts of the story. Suggested summaries are pitched for responders who lack time to digest and communicate what's happening, and Suggestions uses AI to automatically draft updates, summaries and follow-up actions from incident activity. Scribe joins and transcribes incident calls. Missing for 10: substantive documentation of Scribe producing structured call notes (the only evidence is a troubleshooting page mentioning transcription), detail on how live or automatic the summaries are, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
